Emily/Vanessa — copying Rishi's style note but this is Rishi writing: small scope clarifications before we deliver the redacted artifacts so we don't under/over-redact.

Scope we typically include in the hosted API PT bundle:
- External network assessment against public endpoints (api.redwood.ai)
- Auth/authorization flows used by the Hosted API (token endpoints, OIDC flows)
- Basic post-auth functional tests where applicable (rate limit bypass, authz bypass)
- No internal infra A/A credentials or customer data exfiltration proofs included in the redacted report.

Redaction policy we apply: remove unique IP addresses of internal jump hosts, internal monitoring endpoints, and any customer-identifiable data. We will highlight redactions in the redaction map (spreadsheet).

If Acme needs additional artifacts (evidence logs, raw scan output), we can consider an encrypted transfer under an NDA addendum — please indicate that in your reply.

We will also attach a remediation matrix showing which findings are "Closed", "Mitigating Controls Applied", or "Planned" and include expected completion dates for Planned items.

—Rishi
